synopses.movie:129: A young girl becomes trapped in a strange world of spirits. When her parents undergo a mysterious transformation, she must find the courage to free her family.
synopses.movie:329865: After alien craft land around the world, an expert linguist is recruited by the military to determine whether their visitors come in peace or pose a threat.
synopses.tv:94605: Amid the stark discord of twin cities Piltover and Zaun, two sisters fight on rival sides of a war between magical technologies and clashing convictions.
